sources: Owner-approved Saraswati twin cities plan, 14 November 2026
name: Oru

lines.text: Lothal is across the sea. The boat waits in fresh water while the tide makes up its mind.
The boat has room. We wait for water, never for somebody to finish a notebook.
You have looked long enough to see what we were trying to keep. That changes the conversation.
The work you helped us understand is keeping this place useful.
